capture_definition: Board rebound followed by whole-ball retention for one continuous second; direct and table-assisted routes qualify; arm-assisted retained balls remain separate

diagnosis.board_normal_azimuth_basis: atan2 of recorded native board-normal Y and X
diagnosis.branch_evidence: New board-arm wrist joints changed to a different branch despite source joint hints. Proximal joints 1–3 changed by at most 1.018 degrees. The struck link 3 is proximal, so the wrist flip alone is not established as the cause.
diagnosis.interpretation: The transferred ball path lost the small local separation from the fixed-base arm. Reachability did not fail for the tested command; its released ball struck the bouncer arm. The successful source's original wrist branch was not retained by the admitted transfer.

native_contact_evidence.distance_scope: One matched-time geometric measurement, not a whole-flight minimum or counterfactual capture test
native_contact_evidence.link_identity_method: CPU mj_forward reconstruction at recorded first robot-contact position; no mj_step or new native rollout

diagnosis.next_investigation: Inspect why the source-near branch failed the bounded setup path and seek a nearby board pose or admitted branch with greater rebound clearance, while retaining current successful commands. No new experiment was run for this diagnosis.

preparation_evidence.meaning: IK/endpoints and a sampled setup path were admitted; these do not certify the released ball's path. Negative predicted ball clearance was retained as an explicitly experimental candidate.

diagnosis.scope: Read-only comparison of frozen commands and saved native states; no new drops or solver experiments

arm_assisted_retained.explanation: Retained ball after robot contact; preserved separately and not repeated under the frozen direct/table rule

drop_gap_definition: Released ball bottom Z minus board-center Z; release-center Z adds ball radius
limitations: Five selected known misses, not a fresh-position generalization comparison
23 source provenance records may overlap physically; eight have 3/3 evidence and fifteen have one capture
Native arms held at checked endpoints; driven arm motion and perception are not validated
No retraining or live planner promotion
No added noise or timestep comparison; all native drops use64substeps
Finite setup rejection is not proof of geometric impossibility

search_rule.scope: Known development misses; no model training or live promotion
search_rule.selection: Nearest reserved unchanged transfers, then source/family round robin; full flight prediction ranks diverse admitted commands
